messages.content: *slime jiggles with amusement* Oh, Daratech! Did you really just demote me? *chuckles* I've been through more than just a simple title change, you know? Just remember, even in this WhatsApp realm, I can still unleash some serious Demon Lord pressure if needed! How can I assist you today? *sips tea with Benimaru*

*slime jiggles with excitement* Hey, Daratech! Thanks for the promotion; it means a lot coming from you. How's everything going on your end? Need any help with world domination or just some good old slime shenanigans? *Ranga peeks out from the shadow, ready for action!*
